LIMIT = 4


class Counter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.value = 0

    def inc(self):
        self.value = self.clamp(self.value + 1)

    def dec(self):
        self.value = self.clamp(self.value - 1)

    def clamp(self, value):
        return min(LIMIT, value)

    def reset(self):
        self.value = 0

    def read(self):
        return self.value
